description:

Q: The content of the failed 106-line patch: what exactly did the specialist change in +page.svelte that left line 952 untouched? Knowing the decoy logic they grounded on (and any errors/warnings they encountered) would reveal whether there's an obstacle I cannot see from the static source — or confirm that the fix at line 952 is unblocked and the specialist simply missed it.

## Reporter answers (follow-up)

Q: What should the transfer semi-major axis (the second argument to flyHeliocentricSpeed) be for each outer-planet destination? The current code hardcodes Earth-Mars Hohmann (~1.262 AU). The maintainer must choose: (a) compute per-destination Hohmann SMA from DESTINATIONS[activeDestination].a, (b) read a precomputed SMA from the scenario file, or (c) another strategy.
A: I don't know. The notes only say the transfer SMA input itself is not what I'm reporting — keep the inputs as they are; the speed function's out-of-range behavior is the bug. They do not specify which strategy to adopt.

Q: If the answer is (a) per-destination Hohmann SMA, that is a one-line change at line 952 — the specialist's 17-turn failure on the right file suggests this may not be sufficient. What else did the specialist encounter (e.g., flyHeliocentricSpeed being called from a second code path, or the scenario objects having their own SMA override)?
A: I don't know.
